coords: Field feet: home plate origin, +y toward CF, +x toward 1B side, +z up (packages/sim/src/physics.ts).

screen.note: sx, sy are continuous: pixel (i, j) covers [i, i+1) x [j, j+1); draw at floor().

projection: xc = dot(d, right); yc = dot(d, camup); zc = dot(d, forward)
where forward = normalize(target - eye), right = normalize(cross(forward, up)), camup = cross(right, forward), up = (0,0,1), scale = (400/2) / tan(fov_x/2)
sprite_rule: Puppet on-screen height h_px = 6.2 * scale / depth (depth = zc at the feet). Draw the puppet with its anchor (feet) at (sx, sy) of the ground point. Ball: project (x, y, z); its shadow: project (x, y, 0).

cameras.pitch: Broadcast CF camera behind the pitcher (slightly left of center), long lens on the plate. Puppet scale s ~1.3 (pitcher) / ~1.1 (batter): draw the 1x tables unscaled.
cameras.high_home: High behind home plate (upper deck), whole field. Use for balls in play / overview.
cameras.lf: Elevated camera in the left-field seats (30 ft behind the wall, wall+45 ft up) looking in toward the infield; field visible from ~r-75 ft in. Outfield plays, throws home.
cameras.cf: Elevated camera in the center-field seats (30 ft behind the wall, wall+45 ft up) looking in toward home; field visible from ~r-75 ft in. Outfield plays, throws home.
cameras.rf: Elevated camera in the right-field seats (30 ft behind the wall, wall+45 ft up) looking in toward the infield; field visible from ~r-75 ft in. Outfield plays, throws home.
cameras.bleachers: Close shot of the first-base-side stands from shallow foul ground (crowd incidents, raccoons, streakers).

sprite.rule: h_px = 6.2 * scale / depth; s = h_px / 40. If s < 1.4 draw the 28x44 table scaled by s (or unscaled when 0.8 <= s < 1.4); else draw the 56x88 table scaled by s/2. Clamp s >= 0.5 (players are exaggerated in wide shots).
